ctaBodyMinutes: We have your sprinkler schedule on file but we can’t turn the minutes into inches on our own. Add your weekly inches once under Irrigation in My Property and this card shows your rain and sprinkler water together.
ctaBodyDaysOnly: We have your watering days on file but we can’t turn them into inches on our own. Add your weekly inches once under Irrigation in My Property and this card shows your rain and sprinkler water together.
ctaButton: Add your weekly inches in your portal →
longerCyclesLine: Short runs on several days wet only the top of the soil. Put the same water into fewer, longer runs on your allowed watering days and it reaches the roots.
